sourceScopeNotes: Current native React client delegates to public active Strapi job-openings and binds the native numeric identity to an application modal. It displays only role cards and brief plain text, with no full criteria or job-owned publication, expiry, formal requisition or work arrangement. Current API total1 contains Brand Manager, Hyderabad, a ten-character description and no job country. Company headquarters are not job geography; CMS publishedAt is preserved separately from unknown job publication. HR-only global visibility filtering matches the reviewed client. A possible API total beyond its advertised first100 ceiling remains partial rather than inventing pagination. Two complete native snapshots precede caps; all partial/unknown results disable absence and cleanup.
